title: Archery Grouping Radius Trend
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), sprint reps (`sprint:rep`), serve attempts (`serve:attempt`), pickleball rallies (`pickleball:rally`), swim sets (`swim:set`), archery ends (`archery:end`), balance trials (`balance:trial`), and batting reps (`batting:rep`).
app: Sports and skill telemetry from VBT devices, sprint timers, serve trackers, swim logs, archery apps, balance trainers, and batting sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=archery:end
| stats avg(group_radius_cm) as avg_group_radius_cm by bow session_id
| sort avg_group_radius_cm
description: Tracks average grouping radius by bow and session so accuracy improvements are easy to see.
value: Group radius is one of the clearest skill signals because it tells you how tightly your shots cluster even before scoring changes.
implementation: Export session and grouping measurements from an archery scoring app or manual target analysis.
visualization: Line chart of average grouping radius by bow and session.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether your arrows are grouping more tightly over time.
